title: Subscriptions and negative-option billing - federal basics
facts: Federal consumer-protection law prohibits deceptive practices in recurring subscriptions and negative-option offers.
Material terms such as recurring charges and cancellation conditions must not be misrepresented or hidden in a deceptive manner.
Different federal statutes and rules can apply depending on whether the offer is online, by telephone or another channel, and state automatic-renewal laws can add requirements.
A consumer should keep cancellation confirmation and payment records when disputing recurring charges.
